'<div class="bug-comments" title="Has screenshots"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/><polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21"/></svg>' + (b.image_count || (Array.isArray(b.images) ? b.images.length : 0)) + '</div>' : '') +

    let _globalStats = null;  // Preserved stats from full bug list
    function render() {
        // Only recompute global stats when NOT in "mine" filter
        if (!_mineDataLoaded && !activeFilters.has('mine')) {
            _globalStats = computeStats(allBugs);
        }
        if (_globalStats) renderStats(_globalStats);
        renderBugList(allBugs);
    }

    // ── WebSocket for real-time updates ──
    function connectWS() {
        if (ws && ws.readyState <= 1) return;
        let proto = location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
        let url = proto + '//' + location.host + '/ws/bugs/qa';
        try { ws = new WebSocket(url); } catch(e) { scheduleReconnect(); return; }

        ws.onopen = function() {
            wsReconnectDelay = 1000;
            let el = document.getElementById('wsStatus');
            if (el) {
                el.textContent = 'Live';
                el.className = 'ws-status connected';
                setTimeout(function() { el.style.opacity = '0.3'; }, 3000);
            }
            console.log('[BugsQA] WebSocket connected');
        };

        ws.onmessage = function(evt) {
            try {
                let msg = JSON.parse(evt.data);
                handleWSMessage(msg);
            } catch(e) { console.debug('WS message error:', e); }
        };

        ws.onclose = function(evt) {
            let el = document.getElementById('wsStatus');
            if (el) {
                el.textContent = 'Reconnecting...';
                el.className = 'ws-status disconnected';
                el.style.opacity = '1';
            }
            console.log('[BugsQA] WebSocket disconnected code=%d', evt.code);
            scheduleReconnect();
        };

        ws.onerror = function() { /* onclose will fire */ };
    }

    function scheduleReconnect() {
        if (wsReconnectTimer) return;
        wsReconnectTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            wsReconnectTimer = null;
            connectWS();
        }, Math.min(wsReconnectDelay, 30000));
        wsReconnectDelay = Math.min(wsReconnectDelay * 1.5, 30000);
    }

    function handleWSMessage(msg) {
        if (msg.type === 'heartbeat') return;
        console.log('[BugsQA] ws_message type=%s seq=%s', msg.type, msg.sequence || '-');

        if (msg.type === 'bugs_update') {
            if (activeFilters.has('mine')) {
                // Don't overwrite mine-filtered data with full list
                return;
            }
            _mineDataLoaded = false;
            allBugs = msg.bugs || [];
            render();
            return;
        }

        if (msg.type === 'bug_added') {
            let bug = msg.bug;
            if (bug && bug.id && !allBugs.some(function(b) { return b.id === bug.id; })) {
                if (activeFilters.has('mine')) {
                    let me = window.currentUser && window.currentUser.username;
                    if (!me || bug.username !== me) return;
                }
                allBugs.unshift(bug);
                render();
                let addedCard = document.querySelector('.bug-card[data-id="' + bug.id + '"]');
                if (addedCard) addedCard.classList.add('new-bug-flash');
            }
            return;
        }

        if (msg.type === 'bug_status_update' || msg.type === 'qa_review') {
            // Update specific bug status
            let found = false;
            for (let i = 0; i < allBugs.length; i++) {
                if (allBugs[i].id === msg.feature_id) {
                    allBugs[i].status = msg.status;
                    if (msg.qa_ready_at) allBugs[i].qa_ready_at = msg.qa_ready_at;
                    if (msg.qa_approved_at) allBugs[i].qa_approved_at = msg.qa_approved_at;
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (found) render();
            return;
        }

        if (msg.type === 'vote_update') {
            let found = false;
            for (let i = 0; i < allBugs.length; i++) {
                if (allBugs[i].id === msg.feature_id) {
                    allBugs[i].score = msg.score;
                    allBugs[i].upvotes = msg.upvotes;
                    allBugs[i].downvotes = msg.downvotes;
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (found) render();
            return;
        }

        if (msg.type === 'comment_update') {
            let found = false;
            for (let i = 0; i < allBugs.length; i++) {
                if (allBugs[i].id === msg.feature_id) {
                    allBugs[i].comment_count = msg.comment_count;
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (found) render();
            return;
        }
    }

    // ── Filter tabs (multi-select: click to toggle, "All" clears others) ──
    let _mineDataLoaded = false;
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-tab').forEach(function(tab) {
        tab.addEventListener('click', async function() {
            let filterName = tab.dataset.filter;

            // "All" clears all other filters
            if (filterName === 'all') {
                activeFilters.clear();
                currentFilter = 'all';
                document.querySelectorAll('.filter-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); });
                tab.classList.add('active');
                tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
                if (_mineDataLoaded) { _mineDataLoaded = false; await loadBugs(); }
                render();
                return;
            }

            // Toggle filter on/off
            if (activeFilters.has(filterName)) {
                activeFilters.delete(filterName);
                tab.classList.remove('active');
                tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
            } else {
                activeFilters.add(filterName);
                tab.classList.add('active');
                tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
            }

            // Remove "All" highlight when any specific filter is active
            let allTab = document.querySelector('[data-filter="all"]');
            if (activeFilters.size > 0) {
                if (allTab) { allTab.classList.remove('active'); allTab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); }
            } else {
                // No filters active = show all
                if (allTab) { allTab.classList.add('active'); allTab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true'); }
                currentFilter = 'all';
            }

            // If "mine" was just toggled ON, fetch user's bugs
            if (filterName === 'mine' && activeFilters.has('mine')) {
                let token = getToken();
                if (!token && !(window.hasSession && window.hasSession())) {
                    showToast('Please log in to see your bugs', true);
                    activeFilters.delete('mine');
                    tab.classList.remove('active');
                    render();
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    let resp = await fetch(API_BASE + '/bugs/list?per_page=100&mine=true', {
                        headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }
                    });
                    if (resp.ok) {
                        let data = await resp.json();
                        allBugs = data.bugs || [];
                        _mineDataLoaded = true;
                        _apiMineCount = data.total || allBugs.length;
                        let cEl = document.getElementById('countMine'); if (cEl) cEl.textContent = '(' + _apiMineCount + ')';
                    } else if (resp.status === 401) {
                        showToast('Session expired — please log in again to see your bugs', true);
                        activeFilters.delete('mine');
                        tab.classList.remove('active');
                        render();
                        return;
                    } else {
                        console.warn('[BugsQA] mine fetch status=' + resp.status + ' — using client-side filter');
                        if (!window.currentUser || !window.currentUser.username) {
                            showToast('Could not load your bugs — please try again', true);
                            activeFilters.delete('mine');
                            tab.classList.remove('active');
                            tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
                            render();
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    console.warn('[BugsQA] mine fetch error:', e && e.message, '— using client-side filter');
                    if (!window.currentUser || !window.currentUser.username) {
                        showToast('Could not load your bugs — please try again', true);
                        activeFilters.delete('mine');
                        tab.classList.remove('active');
                        tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
                    }
                }
            } else if (filterName === 'mine' && !activeFilters.has('mine') && _mineDataLoaded) {
                // Switching away from "mine" — re-fetch full list
                _mineDataLoaded = false;
                await loadBugs();
            }

            currentFilter = activeFilters.size > 0 ? Array.from(activeFilters)[0] : 'all';
            render();
        });
    });

    // ── Submit Bug Modal ──
    let modal = document.getElementById('bugModal');
    let _lastFocusedEl = null;
    function _openBugModal() {
        _lastFocusedEl = document.activeElement;
        let scrollY = window.scrollY;
        modal.classList.add('active');
        document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
        document.body.style.top = '-' + scrollY + 'px';
        document.body.dataset.scrollY = scrollY;
        document.getElementById('bugTitle').focus();
    }
    function _closeBugModal() {
        if (!modal.classList.contains('active')) return;
        modal.classList.remove('active');
        document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
        let scrollY = parseInt(document.body.dataset.scrollY || '0');
        document.body.style.top = '';
        window.scrollTo(0, scrollY);
        if (_lastFocusedEl) { _lastFocusedEl.focus(); _lastFocusedEl = null; }
    }
    document.getElementById('submitBugBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
        // Audit #20 (ET-18360 family): the access token is an httpOnly cookie,
        // so getToken() is null for valid sessions — gate on SESSION presence
        // or every logged-in user loops through /login forever.
        const _authed = (typeof window.hasSession === 'function') ? window.hasSession() : (!!getToken() || /(^|;\s*)et_session=/.test(document.cookie));
        if (!_authed) { window.location.href = '/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname); return; }
        _openBugModal();
    });
    document.getElementById('bugModalClose').addEventListener('click', _closeBugModal);
    document.getElementById('bugModalCancel').addEventListener('click', _closeBugModal);
    modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === modal) _closeBugModal(); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') _closeBugModal(); });

    let _submitPending = false;
    document.getElementById('bugForm').addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (_submitPending) return;
        let token = getToken();
        if (!token && !(window.hasSession && window.hasSession())) { window.location.href = '/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname); return; }

        let title = document.getElementById('bugTitle').value.trim();
        let desc = document.getElementById('bugDescription').value.trim();
        if (title.length < 5 || desc.length < 20) { showToast('Title must be 5+ chars, description 20+ chars', true); return; }

        _submitPending = true;
        try {
            let resp = await fetch(API_BASE, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token },
                body: JSON.stringify({ title: title, description: desc, category: 'bug', images: bugImages.filter(function(img) { return img !== null; }).map(function(img) { return img.data; }) })
            });
            if (resp.status === 401) { window.location.href = '/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname); return; }
            if (resp.status === 429) { let errData = await resp.json().catch(function() { return {}; }); showToast(errData.detail || 'Rate limit reached. Try again later.', true); return; }

            let data = await resp.json();
            console.log('[BugsQA] bug_submitted id=%d title=%s', data.id, title.substring(0, 50));
            _closeBugModal();
            document.getElementById('bugForm').reset();
            resetBugImages();
            showToast('Bug #' + data.id + ' reported successfully!');
            // The WebSocket will push the update, but also add locally for instant feedback (dedup by id)
            if (!allBugs.some(function(b) { return b.id === data.id; })) {
                allBugs.unshift(data);
            }
            render();
        } catch(err) {
            showToast('Network error. Please try again.', true);
        } finally {
            _submitPending = false;
        }
    });

    // ── Image paste/upload for bug reports ──
    let bugImages = [];
    let bugImageDrop = document.getElementById('bugImageDrop');
    let bugImageFile = document.getElementById('bugImageFile');
    let bugImagePreview = document.getElementById('bugImagePreview');
    let bugImagePlaceholder = document.getElementById('bugImagePlaceholder');

    function compressBugImage(dataUrl, maxW, quality, cb) {
        let img = new Image();
        img.onload = function() {
            let w = img.width, h = img.height;
            if (w > maxW) { h = Math.round(h * maxW / w); w = maxW; }
            let canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
            canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
            cb(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality));
        };
        img.onerror = function() { cb(dataUrl); };
        img.src = dataUrl;
    }
    function addBugImage(file) {
        if (!file || typeof file.type !== 'string' || !file.type.startsWith('image/')) return;
        if (bugImages.filter(function(x) { return x !== null; }).length >= 5) { showToast('Max 5 images allowed', true); return; }
        if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) { showToast('Image must be under 10MB', true); return; }
        let reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            let dataUrl = e.target.result;
            if (!dataUrl || typeof dataUrl !== 'string' || !dataUrl.startsWith('data:image/')) return;
            // Bug #287: Compress large images to prevent body size overflow
            let needsCompress = file.size > 500 * 1024;
            let doAdd = function(finalUrl) {
                let idx = bugImages.length;
                bugImages.push({ data: finalUrl, name: file.name || 'screenshot.png' });
                let wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                wrapper.style.cssText = 'position:relative;display:inline-block;';
                let img = document.createElement('img');
                img.src = finalUrl;
                img.style.cssText = 'max-width:120px;max-height:80px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--panel-border-hover);';
                let rmBtn = document.createElement('button');
                rmBtn.type = 'button';
                rmBtn.textContent = '\u00D7';
                rmBtn.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;background:#ff4444;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:50%;width:18px;height:18px;font-size: 0.75rem;cursor:pointer;line-height:18px;text-align:center;';
                rmBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    bugImages[idx] = null; wrapper.remove();
                    if (bugImagePlaceholder && !bugImages.some(function(img) { return img !== null; })) {
                        bugImagePlaceholder.style.display = '';
                    }
                });
                wrapper.appendChild(img);
                wrapper.appendChild(rmBtn);
                bugImagePreview.appendChild(wrapper);
                if (bugImagePlaceholder) bugImagePlaceholder.style.display = 'none';
            };
            if (needsCompress) {
                compressBugImage(dataUrl, 1280, 0.6, doAdd);
            } else {
                doAdd(dataUrl);
            }
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    // Click to open file picker
    if (bugImageDrop) {
        bugImageDrop.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target.closest('button')) return;
            bugImageFile.click();
        });
    }
    if (bugImageFile) {
        bugImageFile.addEventListener('change', function() {
            for (let i = 0; i < this.files.length; i++) addBugImage(this.files[i]);
            this.value = '';
        });
    }

    // Ctrl+V paste — listen on the drop zone AND the whole modal
    if (bugImageDrop) {
        bugImageDrop.addEventListener('paste', handlePaste);
    }
    if (modal) {
        modal.addEventListener('paste', handlePaste);
    }
    function handlePaste(e) {
        if (!modal || !modal.classList.contains('active')) return;
        let items = (e.clipboardData || (e.originalEvent && e.originalEvent.clipboardData) || {}).items;
        if (!items) return;
        for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
            if (items[i].type.indexOf('image') !== -1) {
                e.preventDefault();
                addBugImage(items[i].getAsFile());
            }
        }
    }

    // Drag highlight
    if (bugImageDrop) {
        bugImageDrop.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); this.style.borderColor = '#00cfff'; });
        bugImageDrop.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { this.style.borderColor = ''; });
        bugImageDrop.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault(); this.style.borderColor = '';
            if (e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files) {
                for (let i = 0; i < e.dataTransfer.files.length; i++) addBugImage(e.dataTransfer.files[i]);
            }
        });
    }

    // Reset images when modal closes
    function resetBugImages() {
        bugImages = [];
        if (bugImagePreview) bugImagePreview.innerHTML = '';
        if (bugImagePlaceholder) bugImagePlaceholder.style.display = '';
    }
    document.getElementById('bugModalClose').addEventListener('click', resetBugImages);
    document.getElementById('bugModalCancel').addEventListener('click', resetBugImages);

    // ── Load via API (fallback if SSR data is empty) ──
    async function loadBugs() {
        try {
            let resp = await fetch(API_BASE + '/bugs/list?per_page=100');
            if (!resp.ok) { console.error('Failed to load bugs:', resp.status); return; }
            let data = await resp.json();
            allBugs = data.bugs || [];
            render();
        } catch(e) {
            console.error('Failed to load bugs:', e);
        }
    }

    // Initial render + WebSocket connect
    if (!allBugs.length) { loadBugs(); } else { render(); }
    connectWS();

    // Cleanup on unload
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
        if (wsReconnectTimer) clearTimeout(wsReconnectTimer);
        if (ws) ws.close();
    });
</script>
